verdict.rationale: Kong provides authentication/authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth, ACLs), Vaults for secret storage, and AI Gateway/MCP governance concepts, which could underpin scoped credential issuance for agents/APIs, but there is no explicit documentation of an API or workflow to issue scoped, least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent identity. missing for 10: explicit agent-specific credential issuance workflow, least-privilege scoping mechanism tied to agent identity, and independent/hands-on evidence of this exact capability in use.
